title: Robbing a Round Street
statement:
`n` houses stand around a circular street, so house `n` is next to house `1`. House `i` holds `a_i` money. You may not take from two neighbouring houses. Find the most money you can take.

With a single house, you may take from it.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the largest total you can take.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 17000`
- `0 <= a_i <= 10^9`
